name: OpenEMM
headline: OpenEMM - Email Marketing Automation
short_description: OpenEMM is a web-based email marketing tool for automating newsletters, multi-stage campaigns, transactional emails, and autoresponders. It helps marketing teams streamline email campaigns, improve engagement, and track performance. It integrates with existing marketing workflows and connects to databases for personalized email content.
author: agnitas-org

sections.overview:
OpenEMM is an open-source, web-based email marketing platform designed for marketing teams to automate newsletters, multi-stage campaigns, transactional emails, and autoresponders. The tool streamlines email campaign creation and execution while providing performance tracking and engagement metrics. OpenEMM integrates with existing databases to enable personalized email content and connects to marketing workflows for efficient campaign management. Users can access the platform through a dashboard interface, with technical documentation available via the OpenEMM Wiki and community support through the OpenEMM Forum.
Automating multi-stage email marketing campaigns
Managing newsletters and transactional email workflows
Creating personalized emails using database integration
Tracking email campaign performance and engagement metrics
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/agnitas-org/openemm`
sections.usage:
```
Set up a multi-stage email campaign in OpenEMM for [PRODUCT_LAUNCH]. The campaign should include a teaser email sent 2 weeks before launch, a reminder email 3 days before launch, and a follow-up email 1 day after launch. Use the target audience segment [TARGET_AUDIENCE] and personalize the content based on their past interactions with our brand. Schedule the campaign to run automatically and set up tracking for open rates and click-through rates.
```
Copy

```
Campaign Setup Confirmation

Your multi-stage email campaign for the [PRODUCT_LAUNCH] has been successfully set up in OpenEMM. Here are the details:

1. Teaser Email:
   - Subject: Exciting News Coming Your Way!
   - Scheduled: 2 weeks before launch
   - Content: A teaser about the upcoming product launch with a call-to-action to sign up for updates.
   - Target Audience: [TARGET_AUDIENCE]
   - Personalization: Includes the recipient's first name and a reference to their last purchase.

2. Reminder Email:
   - Subject: Just 3 Days Until the Big Reveal!
   - Scheduled: 3 days before launch
   - Content: A reminder about the upcoming launch with a countdown timer and a link to the product page.
   - Target Audience: [TARGET_AUDIENCE]
   - Personalization: Includes the recipient's first name and a reference to their browsing history.

3. Follow-Up Email:
   - Subject: The [PRODUCT_LAUNCH] is Here!
   - Scheduled: 1 day after launch
   - Content: An announcement about the product launch with a special discount code for early adopters.
   - Target Audience: [TARGET_AUDIENCE]
   - Personalization: Includes the recipient's first name and a reference to their past interactions with the brand.

Tracking:
   - Open Rates: Enabled
   - Click-Through Rates: Enabled

Your campaign is now ready to go. You can monitor its performance in the OpenEMM dashboard.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
